We want to share the house with you, and us [there are two of us, a man and a wo-m-an], and two cats. We, Kyle and Nicole, are looking for another beautiful human to reside behind door number three. We keep the house clean and organized, and expect the same from you. Slobs need not apply.Room: It's 12' x 10', has two windows, a closet, a door, floor, ceiling, and six walls. Put your life in there, just be neat about it. The overflow can go in the basement, there is storage space.House: We're looking for a housemate, not a hermit who plays video games or lays away on the boob tube. We share the house, so we enjoy it together! If schedules work, we cook, eat, and hang out together. We also share responsibilities. Cleaning up after yourself, and lending a hand around the house, are not only appreciated, but expected in the space[s] you do utilize.There are two cats, they pretty much run the joint. We just work to pay for heat, chicken, string toys, and laser batteries. If you're allergic, look elsewhere. If you don't like cats [or animals in general], we're not going to get along. Bye! If you have pets of your own, unfortunately that won't work. My cats are attention whores and very territorial. They won't let ME sit in certain dining room chairs, imagine another pussy jumping on it! We have tried in the past, it was chaos and cat drama.No smoking of anything in the house. The only smoke these walls have seen in 10+ years is when Kyle makes pancakes. No drugs [alcohol, weed, and mushrooms only].Social: The apartment is on the first floor of a two family house. The upstairs neighbors are cool; they’re a family of five, and we get along well with them. We expect you to have similar consideration for us, and the neighbors, as we do them and you.What we're looking for: We want someone who is nice, neat, clean, and courteous. If you are racist, anti-LGB, uber political [either wing, they're the same dragon], or a religious freak [any denomination, our goddess gave birth to your god], don't waste our time. Go to the next ad.Personal: We are amidst our prime days of midlife fuckery [Kyle is 45 and Nicole is 29, as all women are eternally]. The cats are 1 and 4; so one crazy, rambunctious, asshole kitten, and one beautiful, also sometimes crazy, still-a-baby-to-me, suite young lady.Logistics: $1,200 deposit, $800 rent, utilities split equally [roughly $60-$100 per month, depending on the season], and the water bill is around $70 per person every quarter.It's a busy neighborhood with a lot of little kids playing outside, neighbors walking their dogs, or themselves. Please be respectful of this and don't drive like an asshole. It being mostly two family houses, parking can get tight. We have half of the driveway to share, it fits two cars, and there is street parking.Oh! Communication is incredibly important, please show up if you make a fucking appointment. Rare sense [it is not common anymore].I' have 2 rooms available and am looking for two different people who will be here one to three months. Move-in could start in September or October 1st. There will be 2 people sharing this private space. Or you could sublet the entire space for $700. / month.The space includes a small bedroom that's furnished and has a private entrance and private bathroom that has a tubular skylight and a second bedroom that's furnished that's very large with 2 skylights, a large closet, and a bathroom. The smaller bedroom is $600. and the large bedroom is $700. It's all new construction made with high-end materials, many of which were non-toxic. The kitchen has a skylight and another tubular skylight. There's a washer / dryer in the space.I'll need to see definitive proof that you will be leaving such as plane tickets because eventually I'm going to be using these two rooms for a child that I'm adopting so I need to be sure that whomever is subletting will definitely be leaving. I'll also be looking at your credit score and proof of income. I also will need to meet you in-person. No pets and no smoking.Utilities are extra which usually end up being around $65. to $85. per person per month. Move-in costs for the sublet are first month rent and deposit. I need to talk to people over the phone before having anyone over so call me:. I'm expecting calls about the room so no need to go into a long explanation about why you're calling, just say you're calling about the room for rent. NOTE: I will not have anyone over before talking on the phone first, not only to rule out scammers but also to make sure it's the right fit so neither of us wastes our time

Fully furnished 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, Single family Victorian with spacious backyard. 

Fully-equipped with everything you need (or specify a few things you don't want included, and we can move them out before you move in).

All utilities included except PG&E (gas and electric). Includes gigabit fiber internet, wired ethernet at two desks, and commercial-quality WiFi.

Monthly housekeeping and cleaning included. Additional service available, at your cost.

Driveway and garage parking included - space for two cars. EV charging available, please inquire. Large garage also has space for lots of storage of furniture, boxes, bikes, etc.

Family-friendly neighborhood, close enough to all the action of the Castro and Mission District, but far enough away that the neighborhood is quite, safe, and clean! A terrific park for little kids is just across the street - it has a toddler-sized playground, plus big flat areas for riding bikes or kicking balls. A bigger park, with bigger play structure, is a couple blocks up the hill. Basketball and tennis courts at both parks. "Slow Sanchez" street is a few blocks away - perfect for strolling with dogs or kids.

A few more blocks takes you to Glen Canyon, a terrific wild area with rocks to climb, trails to explore, and maybe even a glimpse of SF wildlife. Easy access to Twin Peaks too - not far as the crow flies, but a big elevation gain - fun workout with a beautiful view.

First showing: Monday, October 5 at 5:00-6:00 PM — reply to confirm.
This full-floor Victorian flat offers more than 1,500 square feet near Divisadero and Alamo Square, with high ceilings, bay windows, wood floors and original period details.
The layout includes three bedrooms and two adjoining front parlors. Pocket doors separate the parlors, each opens onto the hallway, and one has a closet. The flexible layout offers space for living and dining, or a home office while retaining a separate living room.
The eat-in kitchen has a dishwasher, plenty of cabinet space and room for a dining table. There is one full bathroom, a separate second toilet room and a large hallway storage closet. Windows along multiple sides of the flat bring in natural light.
Divisadero's cafes, restaurants and shops are around the corner, with The Mill, Nopa and Bi-Rite nearby. Alamo Square Park is a few blocks away. Nearby Muni service includes the 5/5R Fulton and 24 Divisadero.

Spacious second floor 2-3BR/1BA apartment in Pacific Heights, located directly across from Lafayette Park. Floors are hard­wood except in bath; heat is steam; lights are inset. The flexible layout can accommodate three bedrooms without a separate living room, or two bedrooms with a living room. The mid-unit living room connects to the kitchen and central hallway and features a wall closet with sliding mirrored doors, allowing it to function comfortably as a third bedroom.
Kitchen is at the front of the apartment. Its all stainless appliances include gas stove, microwave and dishwasher. Bedrooms are side-by-side at the rear of the apartment. Both have bay windows. One has a walk-in closet, the other has a wall closet with sliding mirror doors. Beautiful marble bath has shower-over-tub with sliding glass doors. Combo washer/dryer is located in the central hallway in a closet and is next to a walk-in hall closet.
Elegant building is on Sacramento at Gough. Polk Street's extensive shopping and dining district is three blocks away, and it's just 4.5 blocks to Fillmore Street shopping and dining. Walk Score is 94, Transit Score is 85. Van Ness Avenue is three blocks away and bus lines 1, 19, 27 and 49 are all within three blocks.

This enormous 3 bedroom, plus family room, plus formal dining room, and full-size luxury bath unit offers the very best in modern design combined with the original details and coupled with one of the most highly desired neighborhoods in in all of San Francisco.  Views of the Pacific, Golden Gate Bridge and Victorian tree tops on a sunny day!
The private entrance leads into a foyer with stairs leading up to the second floor of this full floor residence.  Unit features a large, open plan living room, dining room and kitchen with large windows, tons of natural daylight.
The remodeled kitchen is a study in sleek simplicity with every detail sculpted to perfection. Yards of lovely countertops, all new custom cabinetry with under cabinet lighting. Appliances include a 4 burner Bertazzoni stove, hood,  refrigerator and dishwasher.  Large sink, and garbage disposal. Plus a large pantry which contains ample storage space.
The adjacent dinging room, with a decorative fireplace and built in cabinetry, and the open floor plan kitchen makes this the perfect spot for entertaining, large and small.
Overlooking the street, above the tree tops, there are 2 bedrooms.  One bedroom has a decorative fireplace.  3rd bedroom is located further down the hall.
Newly remodeled bathroom, high quality tile and fixtures, with a shower over tub.
Miele washer and dryer in a designated laundry closet.
Let’s talk location!  Located right around the corner from the much beloved Buena Vista Park, this lovely flat is situated between the many shops and restaurants of Cole Valley, NOPA, and the Castro. Tons of amazing restaurants and shopping out your door! A short hop to Highways 280/101 for easy southern commutes.
